summary: ING Groep N.V. furnished a Form 6-K (US equivalent of a foreign private issuer current report) attaching a press release dated 22 September 2026 updating progress under its EUR1.0bn share buyback programme launched 30 April 2026. During the week of 14-18 September 2026, 1,350,000 shares were repurchased at an average price of EUR31.92 for EUR43,086,200.00. Cumulative repurchases total 27,660,805 shares at an average EUR28.16, or EUR779,002,867.99, approximately 77.90% of the programme's maximum value. Shares are being cancelled to reduce share capital. Watch pace of remaining execution and any acceleration or suspension signals.
